Plaintext JSON includes notes, tags, ratings, every saved correction and deleted entry identities. Store it somewhere private. Alarms and sensor data are separate. Older copies can still contain nights you later delete.
Export limit: 8 MiB, 10,000 saved revisions and 10,000 deletion markers. Exceeding a limit fails the export; nothing is silently left out.
Journal export verified by reading the saved document back.
Restore completed. Existing nights were kept.

Missing nights and deletion markers are added together. Existing entries and local deletions are kept. Imported markers prevent later old-archive restores; they never delete an entry already on this device. All corrections for added nights are restored together.

The entry and all its saved corrections will be removed from this device. This device will remember its identity to prevent an old archive from adding it again. Future exports include that identity. Previously exported copies are separate.
Using an earlier version saves a new correction. Later versions stay in the history and in exports.
Your journal exceeds this export format’s limit. No journal copy was written and no entries were omitted. All records remain on this device. A format for larger journals is still in development.
The export could not be completed. Your journal is unchanged. Delete the partial document, check the destination and try again.
A document was written, but its contents could not be verified. Do not rely on this copy yet. Check the destination and export again. Your journal is unchanged.
This file could not be read as a supported SolSleep journal archive. Check the file and try again. Your journal is unchanged.

resources.string: Readback checks recorded on this device. Later changes, deletion or cloud uploads are not tracked.
Not verified. This attempt did not reach a recorded completion and may have been interrupted.
The journal copy was not written successfully.
No verified export recorded on this device.
Export history is unavailable. You can still export and verify your journal.
The latest export result could not be fully recorded. Check its result before relying on the copy.
Record the movement your phone observes
Experimental raw accelerometer recording. This does not measure sleep, stages, breathing or snoring. Keep your usual alarm as backup while physical reliability testing is unfinished.
Phone movement only · Tap to see controls
Waiting for the first saved samples
Paused · No data is being captured
Deletion unfinished · Retry to remove remaining files
Missing time stays missing. Resuming creates a new segment; no sleep is inferred between segments.
Allow notifications and this recording channel so the ongoing Stop control stays visible.
Cannot load recording storage. Existing files are retained. If recording is active, use its notification to finish.
The recording command could not finish. Check the saved state below. Existing observations are retained.

This experimental feature saves your phone’s accelerometer readings locally, with the time zone, requested interval and app build identity. Movement is not a measurement of sleep, and battery use and overnight reliability are not yet qualified.
Keep the phone on a firm, ventilated surface, away from pillows and bedding. Recording uses a visible notification and keeps the CPU awake. It does not use the microphone, watch, network or location.
Raw recordings are separate from Journal exports. Finish a recording and use Export recording to save a portable, unencrypted copy. Uninstalling removes data without an external copy. Device storage protection applies; portable encryption is not implemented. Continue only if these limits are acceptable.

Requests about 10 samples per second; actual delivery varies. Saves bounded batches about every 4 seconds. A segment stops after 12 hours, 15 seconds without fresh samples, a clock jump or low storage. A session is bounded to about 64 MiB; a 64 MiB free-space threshold is checked before writing. These are software policies, not measured battery or power-loss guarantees.
A crash can leave progress behind the validated files.
Some files could not be validated. Original damaged files are retained; valid samples are counted separately.

Removes this recording’s raw files and session metadata from this installation. Manual journal entries and alarms stay unchanged. An interrupted deletion can be retried. This is not a secure erase guarantee for flash storage.
Stopped because the recording storage limit or free-space reserve was reached.
Stopped after a clock change. Resume to create a new clock anchor.
The service or process ended. Missing time was not recorded.
Stopped because the accelerometer was unavailable or stopped supplying fresh samples.
Stopped after a storage error. Previously published observations are retained.

Export a finished recording to save its exact motion data, sources and events. These .solmotion files are unencrypted and may contain sensitive timing and movement data. They are separate from journal and alarm exports. Restore keeps existing and locally deleted recordings; nothing starts recording or arms an alarm.
A checked recovery copy is kept on this phone until restore succeeds or you discard it. Interrupted restores can be retried after reopening the app.
The recovery copy could not be checked. Existing recordings are retained. You can discard this copy and choose the original document again.
Recording exported and its destination readback verified. This checks the returned bytes, not future cloud retention.
The recording was written, but destination readback did not verify. Keep the original recording and try another document.
Export did not finish. The chosen document may be incomplete. The original recording is retained.
Recording restored. Original samples, sources and events are retained; no recording was started.
An existing or locally deleted identity takes priority. This copy will not replace it.
Restore did not finish cleanly. Saved data is retained. Recheck the recording list and retry the recovery copy; already published data is never overwritten.
Finish the current recording before restoring a backup.
Remove the private staging copy from this phone? The chosen document and saved recordings remain. Files already published by an interrupted restore are retained for an identical retry.
There is not enough free space to keep a safe recovery copy. Free some space without deleting your original recording, then try again.
